rationale: The plan correctly identifies the paired design and models it as ~ subject + condition in DESeq2 with explicit relevel of the control reference, corroborated by subject-blocked limma-voom and edgeR QL fits, and it explicitly forbids an unpaired test. QC is thorough (library sizes, VST PCA by subject and condition, distance heatmap, dispersion, p-value histogram) but lacks a stated policy for handling an outlier or shallow sample. Filtering, in-model normalization (size factors/TMM), apeglm shrinkage, and stated alphas are all present, though BH is never named explicitly and the enrichment step does not pin a gene-set collection version. Reporting is strong on design caveats (residual df = 4, underpowered) and counts, but software versions are not explicitly required in the output.
